import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x):
    return float(np.round(float(x), 2))


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": num(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly_avail = df["Revenue_LY"].notna().any()

    # ---- Totals ----
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", rev_tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", rev_lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if ly_avail:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", rev_ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if rev_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", round((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly_avail and rev_ly > 0:
        sub = df[df["Revenue_LY"].notna()]
        a, b = sub["Revenue_TW"].sum(), sub["Revenue_LY"].sum()
        if b > 0:
            add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", round((a - b) / b * 100, 1),
                "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 over rows with LY data")

    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_LW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", round((df["Units_TW"].sum() - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", round((df["Orders_TW"].sum() - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- Largest entities ----
    top = df[df["Revenue_TW"].notna()].sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for the entity")
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", round(float(r["Share_Pct"]), 1) if pd.notna(r["Share_Pct"])
            else (r["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else None),
            "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top):
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", top.iloc[0]["Rank"], "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", round(top.head(5)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1) if rev_tw else None,
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- Biggest WoW movers (absolute GBP) ----
    d = df[df["Revenue_TW"].notna() & df["Revenue_LW"].notna()].copy()
    d["delta"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    d = d.sort_values("delta", ascending=False)
    for _, r in d.head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["delta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    for _, r in d.tail(2).iloc[::-1].iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["delta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # ---- Biggest WoW movers (percent, meaningful base) ----
    p = df[df["WoW_Pct"].notna() & (df["Revenue_LW"].fillna(0) > 0)].copy()
    if len(p):
        base = p["Revenue_LW"].median()
        pm = p[p["Revenue_LW"] >= base] if (p["Revenue_LW"] >= base).any() else p
        pm = pm.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False)
        for _, r in pm.head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(float(r["WoW_Pct"]), 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
        for _, r in pm.tail(2).iloc[::-1].iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(float(r["WoW_Pct"]), 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df[df["YoY_Pct"].notna() & df["Revenue_LY"].notna()].copy()
    if len(y):
        y["ydelta"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
        y = y.sort_values("ydelta", ascending=False)
        for _, r in y.head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["ydelta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        for _, r in y.tail(1).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["ydelta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        yb = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False)
        add(yb.iloc[0]["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", round(float(yb.iloc[0]["YoY_Pct"]), 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # ---- Volume leaders ----
    if df["Units_TW"].notna().any():
        u = df.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(u["Entity"], "units", "TW", u["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW) across entities")
    if df["Orders_TW"].notna().any():
        o = df.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(o["Entity"], "orders", "TW", o["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW) across entities")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
